enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed with eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Turns to right side. Stretches legs. Curls up. Moves arm under pillow. Turns onto back. Snores lightly. Moves hand to scratch nose. Turns to left side again. Pulls blanket over head. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning hygiene: washing face, brushing teeth, and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up in bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Washes body with soap. Rinses off. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries body. Turns on sink tap. Washes face. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off light. Walks out.

Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and milk. Closes refrigerator. Turns on induction cooker. Places frying pan on cooker. Adds butter. Cracks eggs into pan. Stirs eggs. Turns off cooker. Places eggs on plate. Puts bread in toaster. Turns on toaster. Pours milk into glass. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Drinks milk. Clears dishes. Turns off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying up the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into living room. Turns on light. Picks up clutter from floor. Places items on shelf. Opens storage cabinet. Takes out vacuum cleaner. Plugs in vacuum cleaner. Turns on vacuum cleaner. Vacuums floor. Moves furniture to vacuum underneath. Vacuums under sofa. Vacuums corners. Turns off vacuum cleaner. Unplugs vacuum cleaner. Winds cord. Puts vacuum cleaner back. Wipes dust off surfaces. Arranges cushions on sofa. Turns off light. Walks out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Using personal computer for leisure: reading news and browsing
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Turns on computer. Waits for computer to boot. Opens web browser. Types news website URL. Reads news articles. Scrolls down. Clicks on links. Watches video. Adjusts volume. Opens new tab. Checks social media. Types comment. Closes browser. Turns off computer. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up. Walks out of bedroom.

Walks into living room. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Sits on sofa. Changes channel. Watches program. Adjusts volume. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out snack. Returns to living room. Sits on sofa. Eats snack. Continues watching TV. Changes channel again. Turns off TV. Puts down remote. Stands up. Walks out of living room.

Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes refrigerator. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Adds oil. Chops vegetables. Adds vegetables to pan. Stirs. Adds meat. Cooks. Turns off cooker. Places food on plate. Sits at table. Eats lunch. Drinks water. Clears dishes. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting and reading on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Lies down on bed. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens reading app. Scrolls through articles. Reads article. Turns page. Adjusts brightness. Continues reading. Puts phone down. Closes eyes. Rests. Picks up phone again. Checks messages. Replies to message. Puts phone down. Turns to side. Continues resting. Picks up phone. Reads another article. Puts phone down. Closes eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing indoor exercise: yoga and stretching
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into living room. Rolls out yoga mat. Stands on mat. Raises arms overhead. Bends forward. Touches toes. Steps back into plank. Holds plank. Lowers to cobra. Pushes up. Sits back on heels. Returns to standing. Does tree pose. Switches legs. Does warrior pose. Switches sides. Lies on back. Does bridge pose. Rolls up mat. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry: washing and drying clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Picks up laundry basket. Sorts clothes into whites and colors. Opens washing machine. Loads whites into washing machine. Adds detergent. Closes washing machine door. Turns on washing machine. Waits for cycle. Opens washing machine. Takes out wet clothes. Opens dryer. Loads wet clothes into dryer. Turns on dryer. Waits for cycle. Opens dryer. Takes out dry clothes. Folds clothes. Puts clothes away. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading a book and listening to music
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into living room. Picks up book from shelf. Sits on sofa. Turns on music player. Selects playlist. Adjusts volume. Opens book to bookmark. Reads page. Turns page. Reads next page. Continues reading. Looks up. Changes song. Returns to book. Reads more. Closes book. Turns off music player. Stands up. Puts book back on shelf. Walks out.

Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Closes refrigerator. Turns on induction cooker. Places pot on cooker. Adds water. Chops vegetables. Adds vegetables to pot. Adds spices. Stirs. Turns off cooker. Sets table. Turns off light. Walks out.

Walks into kitchen. Sits at table. Serves food onto plate. Picks up fork. Eats food. Drinks water. Continues eating. Picks up napkin. Wipes mouth. Stands up. Clears dishes. Places dishes in sink. Turns on tap. Rinses dishes. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out.

Walks into living room. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Opens streaming app. Selects movie. Starts movie. Sits on sofa. Watches movie. Adjusts volume. Pauses movie. Goes to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out drink. Returns to living room. Resumes movie. Watches. Pauses again. Goes to bathroom. Returns. Resumes movie. Finishes movie. Turns off TV. Puts down remote. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer for leisure: browsing and watching videos
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Turns on computer. Opens web browser. Types video website URL. Browsing videos. Clicks on video. Watches video. Adjusts volume. Watches another video. Opens new tab. Checks email. Types reply. Closes browser. Turns off computer. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene: brushing teeth and washing face
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on sink tap. Wets toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face with cleanser. Rinses face. Turns off tap. Dries face with towel. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV in bedroom
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Sits on bed. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches program. Adjusts volume. Lies back on bed. Continues watching. Changes channel again. Watches another program. Turns off TV. Puts down remote. Closes eyes. Rests. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Closes eyes. Falls asleep.

Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Turns to right side. Stretches legs. Curls up. Moves arm under pillow. Turns onto back. Snores lightly. Remains asleep.
